Title: Android Native Developer
Requirements:
- B.Tech, B.E., or MCA in Computer Science
- At least 2 years of native Android application development experience
- Must have solid expertise in Kotlin, Android Development, Jetpack Compose, Retrofit, and SQLite
- Understanding of Android architecture components (MVVM)
Nice to have:
- Experience with Coroutines, Dagger Hilt, and Room Database is a plus
- Experience with Unit Testing (JUnit/Espresso) is preferred
